django-traceid — technical digest
================================

examples/demo/orders/apps.py — AppConfig for the demo orders app.

scripts/gen_context_files.py — Generate the standardised per-repo context files from the repo's own content.
scripts/quality_gate.py
src/django_traceid/__init__.py — django-traceid — end-to-end request/trace id propagation for Django.
src/django_traceid/apps.py — Django application configuration.
src/django_traceid/conf.py — Settings access for django-traceid.
src/django_traceid/context.py — Execution-context storage for the trace id.
src/django_traceid/filters.py — Logging filter that enriches every record with the current trace id.
src/django_traceid/middleware.py — HTTP middleware binding a trace id to each request.
src/django_traceid/rq.py — Trace-id propagation across process boundaries (RQ, Celery, threads...).
tests/__init__.py
tests/settings.py — Minimal Django settings to exercise django-traceid under pytest.
